meta.name: coderabbit-common-errors
meta.description:
Diagnose and fix CodeRabbit common errors and exceptions.
Use when encountering CodeRabbit errors, debugging failed requests,
or troubleshooting integration issues.
Trigger with phrases like "coderabbit error", "fix coderabbit",
"coderabbit not working", "debug coderabbit".

copy.tagline: 排查并修复 CodeRabbit 的常见报错与集成故障
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 CodeRabbit 报错导致代码审查中断,想自己快速解决
copy.tagline_en: Resolve CodeRabbit errors and restore code review flow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if CodeRabbit errors disrupt your code review workflow and you want to fix them yourself.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能对照 CodeRabbit 常见错误清单，分析报错原因，输出修复步骤和验证方法。
howto.when: 当你提到“coderabbit error”“fix coderabbit”等关键词，或遇到 CodeRabbit 报错、调试失败请求、排查集成问题时触发。
